transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.
Next I'll compare per-service span counts and error rates between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms, sum(case when attr_status_code='Error' then 1 else 0 end) errs, sum(case when attr_http_response_status_code>=500 then 1 else 0 end) http5xx FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal' p, service_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2), sum(case when attr_status_code='Error' then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when attr_http_response_status_code>=500 then 1 else 0 end) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: The slow services are clustered around route, travel and basic-info. Next I'll break the abnormal spans down by span kind, span name and pod to see where the latency starts.

input.query: SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind kind, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) p95_ms, sum(case when attr_http_response_status_code>=400 then 1 else 0 end) http_err FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind kind, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) p95_ms FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-route-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-basic-service','ts-admin-travel-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY service_name, kind

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) p95 FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND attr_span_kind IN ('Client','Internal') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,1), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND attr_span_kind IN ('Client','Internal') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3,1,4
